meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把 224x224 的 H&E 组织切片格点映射成空间基因表达值(log1p-CPM),支持按基因符号逐个查询;也能整张切片批量预测,输出「格点×基因」矩阵,可直接交给 AnnData。
howto.when: 当你需要 224x224、约 20x 的 H&E 格点的空间基因表达,或想按符号查询约 19k 蛋白编码基因,或用 histolab 切块后跑整张切片预测时触发。

say.text: 把这张切片用 histolab 切好的格子分批判测,拼成矩阵并接上坐标
say.note: 得到该切片的虚拟空间转录组图谱

say.text: 换 prott5 这个 source,把同一批切片再跑一遍
say.note: 对比不同基因嵌入来源的结果

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude maps 224x224 H&E histology tiles to spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM, querying genes by symbol, and can batch a whole slide into a tiles-by-genes matrix for AnnData.
howto.when_en: Use when you need log1p-CPM spatial expression for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol, or run prediction across a whole slide after histolab tiling.

say_en.text: With source scgpt, predict EPCAM and CD3D for this 224x224 tile
say_en.note: Returns log1p-CPM values aligned to your gene list

say_en.text: Batch-predict this slide's histolab tiles, then build the tiles-by-genes matrix
say_en.note: Gives a virtual spatial transcriptomics map for the slide

say_en.text: Rerun the same tiles with source prott5
say_en.note: Compares a different gene embedding view
